Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>With Govern The Aligment, for example, may I bleed any Met in the
>teable, or just my prey?
>

Only your prey.

All bleed actions are inherently directly at your prey unless specific card
text overrides. Night Moves and Rafaele Giovanni let you bleed your predator.
Kindred Spirits and superior Cat Burglary let you bleed any Methusaleh, etc
etc.

Halcyan 2
